articles.title: Jay’s Circuit: ENHYPEN’s Fashion King Accelerates in GQ Korea x Gentle Monster
articles.description: Photo Credits: GQ Korea + Gentle Monster + Belift Lab + Virgin Music (Japan) + Geffen Records (US) ENHYPEN’s Jay ignites the April 2026 GQ Korea issue with his first solo pictorial for Gentle Monster’s Circuit Collection, channeling F1 speed and raw instinct. This cover story captures his evolution from I-LAND survivor to global style icon. Fans worldwide feel the rush as Jay redefines K-pop’s visual edge. articles.summary: ENHYPEN's Jay appeared in a solo pictorial for GQ Korea's April 2026 issue, featuring Gentle Monster's Circuit Collection with an F1-inspired concept. The cover story highlights his evolution from I-LAND contestant to a recognized style icon in K-pop.
